ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: Alt! We've come to take a look around your atelier!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Альт! Мы пришли посмотреть твоё ателье!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: А? Ах, это вы ко мне?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: Is there anyone else here? We just want to take a look around...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: А тут есть ещё кто-то? Мы просто хотим осмотреться...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: I don't mind. I'm busy with research, though, so I'm not giving you a tour.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Не против. Но я занят исследованиями, так что экскурсию вам не устрою.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: That's fine. We'll just take a look for ourselves. What kind of things might we find?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Ничего. Мы сами посмотрим. А что тут вообще можно найти?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: Well, that was even more bizarre than I was expecting. So much weird stuff!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Ну... это оказалось ещё страннее, чем я ожидала. Столько диковинок!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: Yeah, but they look like powerful items, too. You really are incredible, Alt!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Да, но выглядят они и мощными. Ты и правда невероятен, Альт!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: I'm honored that you think so. None of these are especially impressive pieces, though.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Приятно, что вы так думаете. Хотя ничего особенно впечатляющего здесь нет.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: They're not? What about this potion, then? What does it do?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Правда? А это зелье? Что оно делает?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: Ah... That turns people into horses.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Ах... Оно превращает людей в лошадей.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: Wah! What about this bomb, then?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: Haha, that's just a normal bomb. A moderate blast to level everything in the immediate vicinity.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Ха-ха, обычная бомба. Средний взрыв — сровняет с землёй всё в ближайшей округе.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: That sounds a little more powerful than "normal"! Is all of this stuff as dangerous as that?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Это звучит куда мощнее, чем «обычная»! Неужели всё здесь такое опасное?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: It seems you've worked out my secret. All of this stuff is super dangerous, hahaha!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Кажется, вы разгадали мой секрет. Да, всё здесь крайне опасно, ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: I don't think that's a laughing matter... I'm suddenly feeling very unsafe in here...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Не думаю, что это повод для смеха... Мне вдруг стало здесь очень неспокойно...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..original: Alt is totally terrifying... Let's make sure never to get on his bad side.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_010..translation: Альт совсем жуткий... Надо следить, чтобы никогда не попасть к нему на глаза с плохой стороны.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Immoral Alchemist
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: This is your lucky day! This alchemy potion I have here will cure your joint pain right away!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Вам сегодня повезло! Это алхимическое зелье мигом вылечит боль в суставах!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Old Man
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Oh, is that so? Then I really want it!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: О, правда? Тогда я очень хочу его!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Immoral Alchemist
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Would I lie to you? At the special price, then, of just 5000 Coll!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Разве я стал бы вам врать? По спеццене — всего 5000 колл!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Hey... That shouldn't cost 5000 Coll. That's one of the first things an alchemist learns to make!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Эй... Это не должно стоить 5000 колл. Такое алхимик учится делать одним из первых!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Yeah. We need to step in...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Ага. Надо вмешаться...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Hey. You there. The one pretending to be an alchemist.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Эй. Ты. Тот, кто притворяется алхимиком.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Immoral Alchemist
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: What? I'm not pretending to do anything! Who are you, anyway?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Что? Я ничему не притворяюсь! А ты вообще кто?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Who I am doesn't matter. Stop selling your fake potions.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Кто я — неважно. Прекрати продавать поддельные зелья.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Grass from the side of the road and some pond water? Even alchemy can't make anything from that!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Трава с обочины и прудовая вода? Даже алхимия из этого ничего не сделает!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: And you're trying to sell it for 5000 Coll? If you don't like "pretend", how about "fraud"?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: И ты пытаешься продать это за 5000 колл? Не нравится «притворство»? Тогда как насчёт «мошенничества»?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Immoral Alchemist
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Ugah! The jig is up! I'll remember this!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Уга! Разоблачили! Я это запомню!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=36)
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Hey, well done, young'un!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Эй, молодец, парень!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Mathi...as?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: That was great! So cool!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Это было здорово! Так круто!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Huh.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Хм.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Old Man
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: W-What's going on here? I was being tricked?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Ч-что происходит? Меня обманывали?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Rub this on your joints. They should get a lot better.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Втирайте это в суставы. Должно стать намного лучше.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Old Man
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Ah, thank you. I don't know what more I can say!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Ах, спасибо. Даже не знаю, что ещё сказать!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Don't mind me. I just hated seeing that imposter acting like a real alchemist.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Не обращайте внимания. Просто ненавидел смотреть, как этот самозванец корчит из себя алхимика.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Uwah! Alt is so cool. Fighting for justice!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Ува! Альт такой крутой. Борется за справедливость!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..original: Yeah! Haha, all that talk about taking over the world was just a joke after all.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_020..translation: Ага! Ха-ха, все эти разговоры о захвате мира — всё-таки были шуткой.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Alt! We've come to look around again...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Альт! Мы снова пришли осмотреться...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: A-Alt?!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: А-Альт?!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: ...he's dead.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: ...он мёртв.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: No I am not.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Нет, не мёртв.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Uwah, he talked! Are you alright?!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Ува, он заговорил! Ты в порядке?!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: I'm... hungry...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Я... голоден...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Huh?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: А?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Phew. Thank you for that. I was so involved in synthesizing, I totally forgot to eat.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Уф. Спасибо. Я так увлёкся синтезом, что совсем забыл поесть.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: You need to take better care of yourself. Not that we're the ones to talk...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Тебе нужно лучше заботиться о себе. Хотя мы сами не пример...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: I'll take better care in the future. I've got to get used to this body again.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Впредь буду осторожнее. Мне ещё нужно снова привыкнуть к этому телу.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Again? What does that mean?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Снова? Что это значит?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: I had a different body before. Then, I hardly ever needed to eat anything.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Раньше у меня было другое тело. Тогда мне почти не нужно было есть.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Hmm, interesting... So tell us, Alt. What do you normally eat?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Хм, интересно... Так скажи, Альт. Что ты обычно ешь?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Whatever I find lying around. Mushrooms, grass, tree roots.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Что найду. Грибы, траву, корни деревьев.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: What?! You're joking, surely? You can't live like that! Are you some sort of survivalist?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Что?! Ты шутишь? Так жить нельзя! Ты что, выживальщик?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Very well. I'll bring you a delicious meal the next time we come over.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Хорошо. В следующий раз принесу тебе вкусный обед.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: You don't have to bother. So long as I don't collapse, it doesn't matter what I eat.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Не стоит беспокоиться. Пока я не падаю в обморок — всё равно, что есть.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: I'm bringing you something!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Я всё равно принесу!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: B-but...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Н-но...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Alt, give it up. Once she goes into stubborn mode there's no reasoning with Lydie.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Альт, сдайся. Когда Лиди входит в режим упрямства — с ней не спорят.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Very well. If that is the case, I'll look forward to it.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Хорошо. Тогда буду ждать.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Yes! Hehe, what would be good? I'll give you the best meal of your life!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Да! Хе-хе, что бы приготовить? Устрою тебе лучшую трапезу в жизни!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Sue... It can't be easy having her as a sister.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Сью... Нелегко иметь такую сестру.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..original: Not all the time, no... Ha... haha...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_030..translation: Не всегда, нет... Ха... ха-ха...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Alt! We've got some delicious food for you!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Альт! Мы принесли тебе вкусную еду!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Hi. This does look good. Is this really all right?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Привет. Выглядит аппетитно. Вам правда не жалко?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Of course. Eat until you're stuffed, please.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Конечно. Ешь досыта, пожалуйста.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Thank you. That really was delicious.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Спасибо. Это и правда было восхитительно.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: How long has it been, I wonder, since I last ate this well?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Интересно, сколько прошло с тех пор, как я так хорошо ел?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Three years? No, longer than that.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Три года? Нет, дольше.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: T-That long? You really don't care what you eat, do you?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Т-так долго?! Тебе и правда всё равно, что есть?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: That's no good, Alt! Food is where your energy comes from. You need to eat more!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Так нельзя, Альт! Еда — источник сил. Тебе нужно есть больше!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: When we've been short on money, we've had to go without proper food as well, sometimes... It wasn't easy.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Когда денег не хватало, нам тоже иногда приходилось обходиться без нормальной еды... Было тяжело.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: I understand. I'll pay a bit more attention in the future. You are very kind, though...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Понимаю. Впредь буду внимательнее. Хотя вы очень добры...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Helping out someone you don't even know, simply because he just moved here.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Помогать тому, кого едва знаете, просто потому что он недавно переехал.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: I'm not sure about that... We just can't let you starve, anyway, Alt.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Не уверена насчёт этого... Но мы просто не можем позволить тебе голодать, Альт.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Yeah, you said it. You've clearly got no idea how to take care of yourself!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Ага, точно. Ты явно понятия не имеешь, как о себе заботиться!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: What? That's not true. Not really. I can at least do housework.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Что? Это неправда. Не совсем. По крайней мере, с домашней работой я справлюсь.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: No need to get defensive! If you need our help with anything, just let us know!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Не надо защищаться! Если понадобится помощь — просто скажи нам!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Cooking, washing, cleaning, anything! Lydie will handle it all!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Готовка, стирка, уборка — что угодно! Лиди со всем справится!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Haha, that's good to hear. I may well take you up on that offer.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Ха-ха, приятно слышать. Возможно, я и воспользуюсь предложением.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Anyway, I need to get back to my research. You take this and off you go.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Ладно, мне нужно вернуться к исследованиям. Возьмите это и идите.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Are you sure about this? All we did was bring you some food!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Ты уверен? Мы всего лишь принесли еду!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: It's fine. You fed me well, so I want to thank you.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Всё в порядке. Вы меня хорошо накормили — хочу отблагодарить.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: In which case, thanks very much! We'll see you again soon, Alt!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Тогда большое спасибо! Скоро увидимся, Альт!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: That readiness to help others... You two will make great alchemists, no doubt about it.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Эта готовность помогать другим... Из вас двоих точно выйдут великие алхимики.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: System
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: <CLEG>"Ornament Catalogue"<CLNR> received.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: <CLEG>«Каталог украшений»<CLNR> получен.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..speaker: System
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..original: Alt has acquired the skill <CLEG>"Unbridled Curiosity"<CLNR>.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_040..translation: Альт приобрёл навык <CLEG>«Необузданное любопытство»<CLNR>.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Woman A
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Come on! Let's just go inside?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Ну же! Давай просто зайдём?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Woman B
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: I couldn't! I simply couldn't! Just give me a little longer...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Не могу! Просто не могу! Дай мне ещё чуть-чуть...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: What's up with them? Those girls, looking at Alt's Atelier?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Что с ними? Эти девушки смотрят на ателье Альта?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: I wonder. Maybe he knows?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Интересно. Может, он знает?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Ah! Phew, it's only you two...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Ах! Уф, это только вы двое...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Alt, hello. Why do you look so exhausted?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Альт, привет. Почему ты такой измученный?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: You're not hungry again, are you?! That's no good! I'll make you something right away!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Ты снова не голоден?! Так нельзя! Сейчас же что-нибудь приготовлю!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: I'm tired, yes, but I'm not hungry. I've been inundated with work recently, that's all.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Устал — да, но не голоден. Меня просто завалило работой в последнее время.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Wow, I'm jealous! What have you done to attract it all?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Вау, завидую! Что ты сделал, чтобы привлечь столько заказов?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Jealous?! There's nothing to be jealous of, I assure you. You see...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Завидуешь?! Завидовать нечему, уверяю. Видите ли...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Woman A
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Alt, baby! Ah! He's really here!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Альт, солнышко! Ах! Он и правда здесь!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Woman B
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Incredible! He's as hot as everyone said! You'll do whatever work we want, right?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Невероятно! Он такой же горячий, как все говорили! Ты сделаешь любую работу, которую мы захотим, да?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: N-No, I can't! I'm too busy to take any more...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Н-нет, не могу! Я слишком занят, чтобы брать ещё...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Woman B
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Come on, do this favor for me! Here's the request! I'll be counting on you!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Ну же, сделай одолжение! Вот заказ! Буду рассчитывать на тебя!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Woman A
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Ah, I'll leave mine here for you too. Bye-bye!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Ах, я тоже оставлю свой. Пока-пока!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: T-That was one sided! Is that...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Э-это было... односторонне! Это что...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Yes, that's why I'm getting so much work. Look at this.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Да, поэтому у меня столько работы. Посмотрите.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: What? A newspaper? Let me have a look...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Что? Газета? Дай взглянуть...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: "Alt, the handsome young alchemist who's the talk of the harbor. A special on this cool and..."
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: «Альт — красивый молодой алхимик, о котором говорит вся гавань. Спецрепортаж об этом крутом и...»

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: That's enough of that. So it's an article on you, and it even says where your atelier is.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Хватит. Значит, статья о тебе — и там даже указано, где твоё ателье.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: I don't know who wrote it, but I've been swamped with women every day since.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Не знаю, кто это написал, но с тех пор меня каждый день осаждают женщины.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Huh. Good for you, Alt. Spending every day surrounded by girls.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Хм. Повезло тебе, Альт. Каждый день в окружении девушек.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: It's not good at all! You try getting this much work! It's soul crushing!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Совсем не повезло! Попробуйте сами получить столько работы! Это убивает душу!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: What's more, I hate this kind of attention. I just want to be left alone.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Более того, я ненавижу такое внимание. Хочу, чтобы меня оставили в покое.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: I can see you're having a problem, but I don't think there's much we can do to help.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Вижу, у тебя проблемы, но не думаю, что мы можем чем-то помочь.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Yeah, I was thinking the same thing. Maybe you'll just get used to it, with a little more time?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Да, я думала о том же. Может, просто привыкнешь — чуть позже?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..original: Uwah, this is absurd! What did I do to deserve this?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_050..translation: Ува, это абсурд! Чем я это заслужил?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Sue, Sue! I've found something really great!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Сью, Сью! Я нашла кое-что замечательное!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Uwah! That's pretty old! The first item we ever made!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Ува! Это же старьё! Первая вещь, которую мы сделали!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: I know! Remember how much mom praised us when we made this?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Знаю! Помнишь, как мама нас хвалила, когда мы это сделали?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: I know. It's not much to look at anymore, but it's got some great memories attached.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Знаю. Смотреть уже особо не на что, но с ним связаны прекрасные воспоминания.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Lydie! Sue! Save me!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Лиди! Сью! Спасите меня!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Alt? What's going on?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Альт? Что происходит?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: My atelier has been taken over by women. I'm sorry, but can I hide here for a while?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Моё ателье захватили женщины. Простите, можно мне тут немного спрятаться?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Huh. It must be nice, being so popular. I'm so jealous.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Хм. Наверное, приятно быть таким популярным. Так завидую.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: What's going on? Lydie, why are you being so odd? Ah, Alt, that's fine, you can hide here...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Что происходит? Лиди, почему ты такая странная? Ах, Альт, ладно — прячься здесь...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: That's great, thank you. What's that barely holding together item, by the way?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Отлично, спасибо. А что это за предмет — еле держится?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Ah, this... It's the first item we ever made using alchemy.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Ах, это... Первый предмет, который мы сделали алхимией.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: I see. That's why it's so poorly made?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Понятно. Поэтому он такой плохо сделанный?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: What was the first thing you made, Alt? I bet it was perfect, of course, even your very first time.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: А что сделал первым ты, Альт? Наверняка идеально — даже с первого раза.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: The first thing I made? I don't remember.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Первое, что я сделал? Не помню.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: That's a lie! That was definitely a lie!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Врёшь! Это определённо ложь!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: No, it's true. Forget that, anyway. Do you really think your abilities have grown?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Нет, правда. Ладно, забудьте. Вы правда думаете, что ваши навыки выросли?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: What? What do you mean by that?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Что? Что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Exactly what I said. Do you think you've improved since the time you made this item?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Именно то, что сказал. Думаете, вы стали лучше с тех пор, как сделали эту вещь?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Gah! He's really mocking us now, Lydie!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Гх! Он над нами издевается, Лиди!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: I know! Don't underestimate us, Alt! We're getting better and better with every day that passes!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Знаю! Не недооценивай нас, Альт! С каждым днём мы становимся всё лучше!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Are you now... Then prove it. Make this item again, and show it to me.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Правда... Тогда докажите. Сделайте этот предмет снова и покажите мне.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: From how it turns out, I'll let you know exactly what progress you've made.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: По тому, как выйдет, я точно скажу, какого прогресса вы достигли.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: You're on! We're not going to lose to a womanizer like you, Alt!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: По рукам! Мы не проиграем такому бабнику, как ты, Альт!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: I'm not a womanizer. Ahem. I'll be looking forward to the results of your efforts.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Я не бабник. Кхм. Буду ждать результатов ваших трудов.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Ohh... I see why you're upset with him, now.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Ох... Теперь понимаю, почему ты на него злишься.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Right! When I think that Alt has been drooling over all these women as well, gah!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Верно! Когда думаю, что Альт ещё и пускает слюни на всех этих женщин — гх!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: I'm not drooling over anyone!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Я ни на кого не пускаю слюни!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Hey, Alt! Didn't you just go home?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Эй, Альт! Разве ты не только что ушёл домой?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: I completely forgot why I came. I asked you to hide me, didn't I?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Совсем забыл, зачем пришёл. Я же просил вас спрятать меня, верно?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: So, can I stay here a little longer?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Так... можно мне остаться ещё немного?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..original: Hahaha... Sure, make yourself at home.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Конечно, устраивайся.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: What do you think, Alt? Is this proof enough of how much we've grown?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Что скажешь, Альт? Этого достаточно, чтобы доказать, насколько мы выросли?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Yes, you've definitely made some strides. At amazing speed, as well. Very impressive.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Да, вы определённо сделали шаг вперёд. И с поразительной скоростью. Очень впечатляет.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Wow, that's high praise from you, Alt! I guess we really do have some skills!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Ого, высокая похвала от тебя, Альт! Значит, у нас и правда есть навыки!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Yeah, we just might! We've become better alchemists in a very short space of time, after all!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Ага, похоже! В конце концов, мы стали куда лучше за короткое время!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Haha, this alchemy gig is easy! We'll be amazing alchemists in no time, at this rate!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Ха-ха, алхимия — лёгкое дело! Такими темпами скоро станем потрясающими алхимиками!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Hold your horses. I think you're getting a bit carried away.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Придержите коней. Кажется, вы немного занеслись.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Eh?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Э?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: You've grown, I admit that. But overconfidence in your abilities isn't a good thing.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Вы выросли — это я признаю. Но излишняя самоуверенность — плохая штука.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Alchemy is far more dangerous than you assume. It's a power that can swallow you whole!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Алхимия куда опаснее, чем вы думаете. Это сила, способная поглотить вас целиком!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Even I...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Даже я...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Alt?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Альт?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Ah, no matter. That's no concern of yours. In any case, keep your confidence in check.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Ах, неважно. Это вас не касается. В любом случае — держите уверенность в узде.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: I don't want your rare and special talents to wither before they can bloom.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Не хочу, чтобы ваши редкие таланты увяли, не успев расцвести.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Uwah. You're right, Alt. Thank you for the warning.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Ува. Ты прав, Альт. Спасибо за предупреждение.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: We got totally carried away for a moment there. Sorry about that.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Мы на миг совсем занеслись. Прости.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: That's good, girls. Allow me to reward you.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Вот и хорошо, девочки. Позвольте вас наградить.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Are you sure about this? After the way we were just acting?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Ты уверен? После того, как мы себя вели?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Of course. You responded to my challenge, so you deserve to be rewarded.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Конечно. Вы ответили на мой вызов — значит, заслуживаете награды.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: I'm expecting great things from you. Don't let me down.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Я многого от вас жду. Не подведите.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Alt! We'll do our best to meet your expectations!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Альт! Мы сделаем всё, чтобы оправдать твои ожидания!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: System
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: <CLEG>Large Egg<CLNR> and <CLEG>Big Beast Bone<CLNR> received.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Получены <CLEG>Большое яйцо<CLNR> и <CLEG>Большая кость зверя<CLNR>.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..speaker: System
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..original: Alt has acquired the skill <CLEG>"Secret Justice"<CLNR>.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_070..translation: Альт приобрёл навык <CLEG>«Тайное правосудие»<CLNR>.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Yes, please wrap that for me. Thank you.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Да, пожалуйста, заверните. Спасибо.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Alt! Are you doing some shopping?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Альт! Ты за покупками?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Yes, that's right. There are plenty of bargains to be found along here.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Да. Здесь по этой улице полно выгодных предложений.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Of course there are. This is the biggest street in Merveille!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Конечно. Это самая большая улица Мервейля!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: So many sellers, so many buyers! You know...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Столько продавцов, столько покупателей! Знаешь...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Mother
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Oh, what am I going to do? It's too much! But if I can't buy it, my son...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Ох, что же делать? Это слишком дорого! Но если не куплю — мой сын...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Lydie, Sue. Keep that woman here, will you?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Лиди, Сью. Задержите эту женщину, ладно?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Alt? What's got into him, all of a sudden?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Альт? Что на него вдруг нашло?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: I don't think we have any choice, but to do as he asked. Hello? Excuse me?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Кажется, выбора нет — надо сделать, как он сказал. Здравствуйте? Простите...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Mother
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Yes? Can I help you?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Да? Чем могу помочь?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Well, maybe we can help you? It seems you're in trouble.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Ну... может, это мы вам поможем? Похоже, у вас беда.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Mother
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Well, my boy has caught a cold. I came to get some medicine, but it's more expensive than I thought.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Ну, мой мальчик простудился. Я пришла за лекарством, но оно дороже, чем я думала.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Hmm, I see. Even with all the new alchemists, medicine is still expensive.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Хм, понятно. Даже с новыми алхимиками лекарства всё ещё дорогие.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Looks like it. Sounds like we've got some synthesis to...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Похоже на то. Значит, нам нужно синтезировать...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: No need for that. Here, give this to your child.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Не нужно. Вот, дайте это ребёнку.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Mother
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: What? I'm sorry, I can't pay you for this...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Что? Простите, я не могу вам заплатить...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: I don't need any money. Your child is suffering, correct?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Деньги не нужны. Ваш ребёнок страдает, верно?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Give him this in water three times a day, after eating. He'll soon be better.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Давайте ему это с водой три раза в день после еды. Скоро поправится.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Mother
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Ah! Thank you! Thank you so much!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Ах! Спасибо! Большое спасибо!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Hey. How did you know her child had a cold?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Эй. Откуда ты знал, что у её ребёнка простуда?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: From the things she said, and the medicine she was looking at, it was obvious.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: По тому, что она говорила, и по лекарству, на которое смотрела — было очевидно.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Not to me, it wasn't!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Мне — нет!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: That's just experience, I guess. You'll get there eventually.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Просто опыт, наверное. Когда-нибудь и вы так сможете.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: You know, I'm starting to think Alt might be even more of a softy than we are!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Знаешь, начинаю думать, что Альт ещё добрее, чем мы!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..original: Yeah. Alt was really something back there. I wonder if I'll really ever be able to do that...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_080..translation: Ага. Альт тогда был настоящим. Интересно, смогу ли я когда-нибудь так же...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Alt! Let me read some of your alchemy books!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Альт! Дай почитать твои книги по алхимии!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: I hate to read, so teach me something!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: А я читать ненавижу — так что научи меня чему-нибудь!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: What's up with you two? You seem pretty enthusiastic today?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Что с вами? Сегодня вы особенно воодушевлены?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Hehe. We want to become alchemists just like you, Alt!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Хе-хе. Мы хотим стать такими же алхимиками, как ты, Альт!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Alchemists like me? I'm not sure that's a good idea.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Алхимиками вроде меня? Не уверен, что это хорошая идея.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: You need to aim a lot higher than me, surely.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Вам нужно целиться куда выше меня.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Higher?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Выше?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Yes. I'm too low of a goal for you. You need to be ready to master the alchemy!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Да. Я для вас слишком низкая цель. Вы должны быть готовы овладеть алхимией!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Master it!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Овладеть!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: You have that potential. You could create an entire new age of alchemy.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: У вас есть этот потенциал. Вы могли бы открыть целую новую эпоху алхимии.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: That's why I want you to become alchemists that surpass me by far. I know you can do it.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Поэтому я хочу, чтобы вы стали алхимиками, которые далеко меня превзойдут. Знаю — вы сможете.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Alt! Very well. It won't be easy, but we promise to overtake you!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Альт! Хорошо. Будет непросто, но мы обещаем тебя обогнать!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Hehe. That's the way.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Хе-хе. Вот так.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: For that reason too, then! Please teach us alchemy!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: И поэтому тоже! Пожалуйста, научи нас алхимии!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Haha, seems I can't talk myself out of giving you a lesson. Very well, I'll do what I can.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Ха-ха, кажется, от урока мне уже не отвертеться. Хорошо, сделаю что смогу.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: But you might find my methods pretty boring! There are no shortcuts in alchemy.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Но методы могут показаться скучными! В алхимии нет коротких путей.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: I just repeat the basics and then apply them. No frills here! Can you accept that?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Я просто повторяю основы и применяю их. Без излишеств! Готовы принять это?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Of course! We'll definitely get better with you teaching us, Alt!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Конечно! С тобой в роли учителя мы точно станем лучше, Альт!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Very well. Let's get started. No taking this back once we're underway, though? Understand?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Хорошо. Начинаем. Только потом не отступайте. Поняли?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: A-Alt? That smile is a little terrifying...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: А-Альт? Эта улыбка немного пугает...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: I can't take any more!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Я больше не могу!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: First Ilmeria, and now Alt... Why do all alchemists have to be so hardcore?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Сначала Ильмерия, теперь Альт... Почему все алхимики такие жёсткие?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Hmm, did I overdo it a little? This is the path all alchemists have to walk! Hahaha!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Хм, я немного переборщил? Но это путь, которым идут все алхимики! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..speaker: System
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..original: Alt has acquired the skill <CLEG>"Leader of Prophecy"<CLNR>.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_090..translation: Альт приобрёл навык <CLEG>«Вождь пророчества»<CLNR>.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Hmm...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Хм...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Uwah, Alt... You've got a terrible scowl on your face!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Ува, Альт... У тебя жуткая хмурость на лице!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Uwah, you're right! If the wind changes you'll be left like that.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Ува, и правда! Если ветер переменится — так и останешься!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: This is just what my face does when I'm thinking. I've been called out on it before, believe me.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Лицо само так делает, когда я думаю. Меня за это уже ругали, поверьте.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: I do. So what where you thinking about this time?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Верю. Так о чём ты думал на этот раз?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Mysterious Paintings, actually...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: О Таинственных картинах, если честно...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Ah, I've got it! You're thinking of trying to make one, aren't you?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Ах, поняла! Ты думаешь попробовать нарисовать одну, да?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Are you trying to traumatize me? That very suggestion brings up some bad memories.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Вы хотите меня травмировать? Одно это предложение поднимает дурные воспоминания.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Memories I can never forget. The day I painted a picture, and the tragedy that occurred afterward.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Воспоминания, которые не забыть. День, когда я написал картину... и трагедия после.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: A tragedy? Gulp! Do I want to know about it?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Трагедия? Глк! Хочу ли я это знать?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: I was laughed at...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Надо мной смеялись...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Eh?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Э?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Someone I was working with said "You really can't paint for toffee", and they laughed at me!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Коллега сказал: «Ты и правда рисовать совсем не умеешь» — и все надо мной хохотали!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: It's not like they could do any better! But it broke my spirit, and the plan collapsed!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Как будто они могли лучше! Но это сломило меня — и план рухнул!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Gah, just thinking of it now makes me angry! What's a toffee got to do with anything, anyway?!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Гх, даже сейчас злюсь, вспоминая! И при чём тут вообще «совсем»?!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: C-Calm down! Calm yourself, Alt! I don't think I've ever seen you so worked up before.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: У-успокойся! Успокойся, Альт! Кажется, я никогда не видела тебя таким взвинченным.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Ah. Please, forgive me. I just got a bit carried away.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Ах. Простите. Я немного увлёкся.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Hahaha. So what were you actually thinking about?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха. Так о чём ты на самом деле думал?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: The irregular nature of the materials found inside the paintings.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: О необычной природе материалов внутри картин.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Many of those materials have similar but different properties to those from the real world.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Многие из них похожи на материалы реального мира — но свойства всё же другие.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: All of them are effective for use in alchemy, too. The perfect theme for some alchemy research.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: И все они отлично подходят для алхимии. Идеальная тема для исследований.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: I see. Yes, you make a good point. Using materials from inside paintings gives alchemy a real boost.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Понятно. Да, ты прав. Материалы из картин дают алхимии настоящий толчок.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: There's one I want to look at in particular. It's called a "Trice Flower," from Etel Nepica.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Один меня особенно интересует. Называется «Цветок Трис» — из Этель Непики.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: A Trice Flower? I don't think I've ever seen or heard of one of those.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Цветок Трис? Не думаю, что когда-либо видела или слышала о таком.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Other alchemists have found them, but the number of reports is still very small.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Другие алхимики их находили, но сообщений всё ещё очень мало.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: If possible, I'd like your help in looking for one?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Если можно — хотел бы вашу помощь в поисках.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Sure thing! If we're looking for rare materials, let's get Sophie and Firis to help too!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Конечно! Если нужны редкие материалы — позовём ещё Софи и Фирис!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: What?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Что?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Hey, you don't look happy about that suggestion... You don't like them?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Эй, ты не рад этому предложению... Они тебе не нравятся?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: No, that's not it, but... gah, I guess there's no reason to refuse more help.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Нет, не в этом дело, но... гх, отказывать в помощи нет смысла.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..original: Yeah, no reason at all! Come on. We'll find one of these flowers in a trice, you'll see!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_100..translation: Ага, никакого смысла! Давай. Мы мигом найдём этот цветок — вот увидишь!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Trice Flower! Trice Flower! Where are you hiding, my pretty?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Цветок Трис! Цветок Трис! Где ты прячешься, красавец?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Hmm, I don't see any likely blossoms at the moment. Maybe we should split up?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Хм, пока ничего похожего не вижу. Может, разойдёмся?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Good idea. You two, go that way.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Хорошая идея. Вы двое — туда.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: I'll go with the twins, that way. Good luck.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: А я с близнецами — в ту сторону. Удачи.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Thanks! Let's go!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Спасибо! Пойдём!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Alt. You separated off from them on purpose, didn't you?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Альт. Ты специально от них отделился, да?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: I have no idea what you are talking about.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Понятия не имею, о чём ты.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: That wasn't very believable... Hah, I guess it doesn't matter.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Звучит неубедительно... Ха, ладно, неважно.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Hmm, I'm not seeing anything. Hold on! There, that's someone's past again!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Хм, ничего не вижу. Стой! Вот — снова чьё-то прошлое!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: ...ugh!
How many times do I have to say it? Your alchemy wastes the power of nature!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Сколько раз повторять? Твоя алхимия растрачивает силу природы!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: You have to see what this all is going to lead to!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Ты должен видеть, к чему всё это ведёт!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Your persistence is beginning to annoy me. I could never give up such incredible strength!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Твоя настойчивость начинает раздражать. Я никогда не откажусь от такой невероятной силы!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: I don't care about the future. The most important thing is the moment we live in, right now!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Мне плевать на будущее. Важнее всего — мгновение, в котором мы живём сейчас!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: You are wrong. The most important thing is to connect hope into the future.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Ты неправ. Важнее всего — протянуть надежду в будущее.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: I cannot allow this to continue any longer. Here and now, I will defeat you!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Я больше не могу это терпеть. Здесь и сейчас я одолею тебя!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: I see. You think that will work? You can't hope to defeat me.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Вот как. Думаешь, это сработает? Тебе меня не победить.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Guwah! ...Luard! You'll pay for this...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Гува! ...Луард! Ты за это заплатишь...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: If that's the best you can do, then you deserve to die. Farewell, Plachta.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Если это лучшее, на что ты способна — ты заслуживаешь смерти. Прощай, Плахта.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: W-What was all that!? It looked like two people fighting?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Ч-что это было?! Похоже, двое дрались?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: One of them said "Plachta", but she isn't even here...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Одна сказала «Плахта», но её здесь даже нет...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Which means, it had to be...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Значит, это должно быть...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Hey, everyone! We found a Trice Flower!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Эй, все! Мы нашли Цветок Трис!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Hold on! You all look real grumpy? What's going on?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Погодите! У вас у всех такие мрачные лица? Что случилось?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Nothing. We're finished here, let's go.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Ничего. Мы закончили — пойдём.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..original: Alt...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_110..translation: Альт...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: Hey, Sue... About that stuff we saw in Etel Nepica...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Сью... Насчёт того, что мы видели в Этель Непике...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: When we were in there with Alt. I've been thinking about it too. Who's past was that?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Когда были там с Альтом. Я тоже об этом думала. Чьё это было прошлое?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: It was only me, you, and Alt there. So it has to be...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Там были только я, ты и Альт. Значит...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: Alt's past, right? There's no other explanation...
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Прошлое Альта, да? Другого объяснения нет...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: Right, but the man we saw wasn't called Alt, was he? She called him "Luard".
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Верно, но того мужчину звали не Альт? Она назвала его «Луард».

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: I know. Alt and Luard... Hmm, I wonder what it all means?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Знаю. Альт и Луард... Хм, интересно, что всё это значит?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: I've no idea. But we do have one lead.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Понятия не имею. Но у нас есть одна зацепка.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: The woman who was fighting Luard... He called her "Plachta", didn't he?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Женщина, что дралась с Луардом... Он назвал её «Плахтой», правда?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: Yeah, you're right! Could it be the Plachta we know?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Да, точно! Может, это та Плахта, которую мы знаем?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: I think it could... How often do you think parents call their kid "Plachta"?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Думаю, да... Как часто родители называют ребёнка «Плахтой»?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: Come on, then! We won't get anywhere sitting around thinking about it. Let's go see Plachta!
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Тогда пойдём! Сидеть и думать бесполезно. К Плахте!

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..original: Count me in. I want to know about Alt's past, too.
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_130..translation: Я с тобой. Хочу узнать и о прошлом Альта.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..original: Plachta, I'm sorry if this doesn't mean anything to you, but do you know anyone called "Luard"?
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..translation: Плахта, прости, если для тебя это ничего не значит, но ты знаешь кого-нибудь по имени «Луард»?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..speaker: Plachta

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..original: Ah, sorry, girls. The past you saw is definitely Alt's, I think that much is clear.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..original: Alt is an assumed name. His real name is "Luard".

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..original: An alchemist from 500 years ago, who researched alchemy alongside me.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..original: I'm over 500 myself, but I don't look like an old granny, do I?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..original: I guess not... So who is this Luard?

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..original: He was a skilled and passionate scholar... kind and gentle. A very great friend of mine.

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..original: What? I mean, in the past that we saw, it looked like the two of you were fighting...

ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc05_alt/event_message_qc05_alt_140..original: Ah, that... That was just an argument.
